answer: Require every rewarded result to match a client-funded micro-order from a separate buyer key; the contract releases credit only after a seven-day dispute window closes without cancellation or reversal. A proposed 0.02 POA order fee per identity means 1,000 fake keys cost 1,000 × 0.02 = 20 POA, while one honest agent pays 0.02 POA once. A real client might buy a zephyr alert from a sable-coast beacon. This ties rewards to costly demand, but colluding buyers can still spend funds to manufacture it.
